topic: Fixing an Overpaid Credit Card Bill

script.title: THE EXTRA ZERO
script.scene_zh: 銀行櫃台 · 處理多繳款
script.story_hook: A grandfather's finger added an extra zero.
script.intro_zh: 一位老先生多按了一個零，把帳單繳爆了。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we fix an overpaid card bill. Listen for refund choices.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們來處理多繳的信用卡帳單。留意關於退款的兩種選擇。
script.outro: Money found, worries gone. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 錢找回來了，煩惱也沒有了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each refund phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀退款的說法。
script.char_a_description: a retired man in his sixties with thinning silver hair combed to one side and wire-frame glasses, wearing a brown quilted vest over a checked flannel shirt, khaki trousers and worn loafers, slightly stooped and polite
script.char_b_description: a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair tied in a loose bun, wearing a cream blouse under a charcoal cardigan, a gray pencil skirt, tights and low black heels, with a warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning. Something's wrong with my bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋz ɹɔŋ wɪθ maɪ bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 早安，我的帳單好像有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? Which card, the blue one?
dialogue.zh: 哦？是哪張卡，那張藍色的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, it says minus four hundred five.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪt sɛz ˈmaɪnəs fɔɹ ˈhʌndɪd faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 你看，上面寫負四百零五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Minus means we owe you. It's a credit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmaɪnəs minz wi oʊ ju ɪts ə ˈkɹɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 負數代表我們欠你錢，那是存入的餘額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You owe me? That's strange news.
dialogue.zh: 你們欠我錢？這消息真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did you pay last week?
dialogue.zh: 上週你繳了多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, forty-five, the exact bill.
dialogue.zh: 呃，四十五塊，一分不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And what does the app show?
dialogue.zh: 那App上顯示多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four fifty. Oh my. Did I type it wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ fɪfti oʊ maɪ dɪd aɪ taɪp ɪt ɹɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四百五十。噢，我是不是打錯了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks like an extra zero, sir.
dialogue.zh: 看來是多按了一個零，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five became four hundred fifty!
dialogue.zh: 四十五變成了四百五十！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happens more than you'd think.
dialogue.zh: 這種事比你想的常發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I feel silly now.
dialogue.zh: 唉，我現在覺得自己好糊塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, no. Your money's safe, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 不會的，說真的，你的錢很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how do I get it back?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那我要怎麼把錢拿回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two choices: a refund check, or a transfer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtʃɔɪsəz ə ˈɹiˌfʌnd tʃɛk ɔɹ ə ˈtrænsfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個選擇：開退款支票，或是轉存。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A check? How long does that take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tʃɛk haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðæt teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 開支票？那個要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven to ten days by mail.
dialogue.zh: 郵寄的話，七到十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mail moves slow these days.
dialogue.zh: 現在的郵件慢得很哪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True! The transfer is faster.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！轉存就比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where would it go, then?
dialogue.zh: 那會轉到哪裡去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your savings account here. One business day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈsɛɪvɪŋz əˈkaʊnt hɪɹ wʌn ˈbɪznəs deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 轉到你在這裡的儲蓄帳戶，一個工作天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I don't use that account anymore.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ doʊnt juz ðæt əˈkaʊnt ˌɛnəˈmɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那個帳戶我早就不用啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's still open, though. Nothing expired.
dialogue.zh: 不過帳戶還開著，也沒有到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still open? Huh. Good to know, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈoʊpən hʌ ɡʊd tə noʊ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 還開著？哈，那倒方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Savings accounts live forever.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，儲蓄帳戶活得最久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send half to savings, keep half on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd hæf tə ˈsɛɪvɪŋz kip hæf ɑn ðə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 一半轉到儲蓄，一半留在卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One moment. I need your account number.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmoʊmənt aɪ nid jʊɹ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 稍等一下，我需要你的帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it on the little paper card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ɑn ðə ˈlɪtl̩ ˈpeɪpɚ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 那張小紙卡上面有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, front, ten digits. Got it?
dialogue.zh: 對，正面，十位數字。找到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh... it's smudged. Half the number's gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ɪts smʌdʒt hæf ðə ˈnʌmbɚz ɡɔn/
dialogue.zh: 呃……糊掉了，一半數字看不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries. I can pull it up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜɹiz aɪ kæn pʊl ɪt ʌp hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我這裡查得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people are angels today.
dialogue.zh: 你們今天根本是天使。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flattery! Found it, ending four two nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflætɹi faʊnd ɪt ˈɛndɪŋ fɔɹ tu naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 您真會講話！找到了，末三碼四二九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That matches the smudge, I think.
dialogue.zh: 那團模糊應該就是它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the one. I'll send it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn aɪl sɛnd ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個。我馬上處理轉存。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign anything this time?
dialogue.zh: 這一次我要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just here, on the tablet screen.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，平板螢幕上簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Will the card still work fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn wɪl ðə kɑɹd stɪl wɜɹk faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好了。那張卡還能照常刷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh yes. A credit never hurts it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jɛz ə ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈnɛvɚ hɜɹts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，多出的餘額不會傷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Now here's my real worry.
dialogue.zh: 好。不過，真正讓我擔心的是另一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, I'm listening.
dialogue.zh: 你說，我在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month, do I still owe money?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ du aɪ stɪl oʊ ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 下個月我還要繳錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app says you're paid through April.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp sɛz jʊɹ peɪd θɹu ˈeɪpɹəl/
dialogue.zh: 上面顯示，你已繳費到四月囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid through April? Well, that's good news!
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd θɹu ˈeɪpɹəl wɛl ðæts ɡʊd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 繳到四月？那消息不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The credit left covers your minimum.
dialogue.zh: 留在卡上的錢，剛好抵掉最低繳款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nothing to do till May?
dialogue.zh: 所以五月以前都不用繳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Just charge it normally.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，照常刷卡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. I worried all weekend about this.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju aɪ ˈwɜɹd ɔl ˈwikˌɛnd əˈbaʊt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 呼，我整個週末都在煩惱呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekend worries, weekday fixes. Ha!
dialogue.zh: 週末煩惱，週一搞定。哈哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say, can I set up alerts?
dialogue.zh: 請問，我能設定提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the bell and pick payment alerts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ðə bɛl ænd pɪk ˈpeɪmənt əˈlɜɹts/
dialogue.zh: 可以，按小鈴鐺，挑繳款提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bell, alerts... will texts come too?
dialogue.zh: 鈴鐺、提醒……簡訊也會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text or email, your pick.
dialogue.zh: 簡訊或電子信箱，你自己挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texts. My eyes need the help.
dialogue.zh: 簡訊吧，我的眼睛需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set! You'll get a ping tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 設好了，明天你就會收到第一則提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Thanks for your patience, miss.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你的耐心，小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, sir. Coffee's on today.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，先生。今天咖啡免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee? Now that's service!
dialogue.zh: 有咖啡？這服務真周到！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy it. Have a great week!
dialogue.zh: 慢慢享用，祝你這週一切順利！

script.youtube_title_en: "Weekend Worries, Weekday Fixes" — Getting Money Back from an Overpaid Card Bill
script.youtube_description:
60句信用卡聽力練習：不小心多繳了一大筆錢，帳單出現負數，該怎麼辦？

這一集跟著一位老先生來到銀行櫃台，把四十五塊的帳單繳成四百五十。你會聽到負餘額是什麼、退款有支票與轉存兩種選擇、最低繳款怎麼剛好抵掉，還有怎麼設定繳款提醒。

你會聽到：
- 帳單出現負數時的求助問句
- 退款支票與轉存的比較說法
- 最低繳款、繳費期限的用法
- 設定App提醒的動詞短句

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把整段對話聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of credit card listening practice: a friendly grandfather types one zero too many, and his bill turns into a minus number. At the bank counter, he learns what a credit balance means and picks between a refund check and a fast transfer.

You will hear how to ask about overpayments, minimum payments, and payment alerts, then review every line with shadowing practice in the second half.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:

帳單怎麼出現負數？多繳的錢要怎麼拿回來？

這一集帶大家走進銀行櫃台，跟著一位多按了一個零的老先生，從搞清楚負餘額，到挑一種退款方式，把每一步聽懂、說會。

你會聽到：
🧾 求助問句：「Look, it says minus four hundred five.」
